summary:
Billing closed cleanly this week, and the client stopped asking for anything. That is the churn alarm on this book. Last window she asked 3 things (wire status, a custom's price, her missing customs). This window she asked 0. All 8 of her messages are short acknowledgements or billing replies ('Amazing !! Thank you Mayson', 'Thank you will do xx', 'Will send shortly'). She also overpaid: Stephski confirmed on 10-15 'we recieved! it was $3189 so i rolled over the over payment below', against a $2,224.88 remainder. She answered the Oct 1-14 invoice within a minute of it landing. Fast payment plus zero asks is the exit pattern, not health.

On ALTR's side the week was busy but mostly about ALTR, not her. A third customs owner arrived in three weeks (Ronnie, then Aroosha on 10-05, then Spencer P on 10-13: 'Ill be handling all customs, content uploads, and backend chat assistance'). A new AM, Jeremy Tarr, introduced himself as working 'alongside Nate, Ronnie, and Sophie'. In this chat, Nate last posted 2026-01-21, Sophie 2025-10-27, and Ronnie has been silent 23 days. Nobody has written that her lost 09-24 customs were found and delivered. Aroosha posted a new custom on 10-11 without mentioning them, and the 10-08 top-spender request has no update. Her link in bio flip-flopped in 4 days. Mayson told her on 10-11 to put lizaswrld.com back ('it won’t get flagged and it’s completely safe'). On 10-12 he debugged it with Vivek in her group chat ('@fonta is the domain the problem?' / 'Yes'). On 10-15 he wrote: 'We've taken the domain down, so please remove it from your bio'. Her 09-24 question 'What exactly you need , reels/ picks?' is now 22 days unanswered. Mica went back to a bare 8-link reel-inspo drop (10-14), which got no reply. Vivek spoke for the first time in 42 days, but only about the domain. There is still no written status on her three IG accounts.

SECURITY: no new credentials were posted this window. Her plaintext IG passwords (08-31, and Michelle's 09-12 re-post) and the live 2FA code she posted for the IG farm vendor on 10-08 are still in the chat: never disclosed, deleted, or rotated (46 days). Two more members were added on 10-13. Derrek has been silent 73 days, and the $5,000 under-credit is 37 days unacknowledged. Wins: Melissa sent a written earnings/performance report (10-09). Stephski caught the non-arrival herself this time (10-12) instead of the client finding it, and confirmed receipt with a number. Both new staff introduced themselves properly, which the IG vendor never did.

health.rationale: Down 5 from 48. Billing operations improved. Stephski flagged on 10-12 that the remainder had not arrived, before the client noticed. That is the first time ALTR, not Liza, caught a missing wire. She then confirmed $3,189 received with a number (10-15) and sent the Oct 1-14 invoice on schedule with a 2-day heads-up. Melissa delivered a written two-week earnings/performance report. That health is outweighed by the client's behaviour. Client asks fell from 3 to 0, against an asks trend of 4, 0, 1, 0, 3, 0 since 09-11. All 8 of her messages are acknowledgements or billing (client messages 37 -> 8). She overpaid the remainder ($3,189 vs $2,224.88 owed) and replied 'Will send shortly' to the new invoice within 1 minute. Per the churn-signature pattern, prompt settling with zero asks is what leaving looks like. Churn signals, 2 of 4 present. (1) PRESENT: owner silent 73 days (Derrek last posted 2026-08-04). (2) ABSENT: no results question this window, and Melissa's report was written, not a call offer. (3) PRESENT: long-promised deliverables with no written proof. Those are the Phone Farm updates (promised 08-01, 76 days), the paid-ads stats (promised 2025-11-18), the IG recovery status for 3 handles (46 days), and written confirmation that her 09-24 customs were delivered (22 days). (4) ABSENT this week: billing was 8 of 21 ALTR messages (38%), down from 57%. Both tells are present: zero asks and fast/over payment. Aggravating: customs owner churn (3 owners in 3 weeks); the link-in-bio reversal plus internal debugging in her chat; 'reels/ picks?' 22 days unanswered; Mica reverting to bare inspo links; credentials and 2FA still sitting in a room that grew by 2 more members.

Still unanswered at 22 days, across four windows. On 10-14 Mica posted 8 bare reel-inspo links in the same Social Media topic without answering it. That drop got no reply, unlike her concrete 10-06 tip. The Drive upload stays blocked on ALTR. Spencer P now says he owns 'content uploads', so ownership of the answer is unclear.
